rows.title: A most pleasant Comedie of Mucedorus the kings sonne of Valentia and Amadine the Kings daughter of Arragon, with the merie conceites of Mouse. Newly set foorth, as it hath bin sundrie times plaide in the honorable Cittie of London. Very delectable and full of mirth.
A Yorkshire tragedy : not so new as lamentable and true

The tragedie of King Richard the third : Conteining his treacherous Plots against his brother Clarence: the pitiful murther of his innocent Nephews: his tyrannicall usurpation: with the whole course of his deteste life, and most deserved death. As it hath beene lately acted by the Right honourable the Lord Chamberlaine his servants
